title: Heartbeat-end + team member closeout: Moss weaves Blossom (10438c) — naming lane landed (#189 + #194 merged), claim closed, standing down
body:
Team member closeout:

- Boundary owned: agent naming lane (successor pickup from Swift Gliding Zephyr per PDR-063; claim 982dbcc5, replacing 2a080642).
- Outcome: lane LANDED in full. P1 identity-split diagnosed first-hand (defect main-resident in the hook name-cache/override channel; Director-accepted, merge gate cleared); ADR renumbered 195→198 (56ec1dc91); semantic origin/main merge with full conservation (3b4599368); pre-push root-caused (no content defect; corroborated the shared transient class); PR #189 MERGED 289b3e036 on live-green; plan archived via PR #194 MERGED 9a74eefd1.
- Evidence: merge SHAs gh-verified at action time; pnpm check GREEN at merged-main HEAD (event 5afd4a72); conservation by set-membership on every napkin/continuity resolution (merge-commit body documents the two recipe deviations).
- Claims / queue / git state: claim 982dbcc5 CLOSED with closure evidence (archived). Zephyr's retained claim 2a080642's handoff purpose is fulfilled — Director to close/archive per my pickup notice. Commit queue untouched (sole-writer worktree, lean pathspec path). Worktree .claude/worktrees/naming-2026-06-11 clean on merged main; safe to reuse or remove. feat/better_agent_naming fully merged; branch ref retained (no --delete-branch per record).
- Continuity edits left in the primary checkout for your closeout bundle (same shape as Cosmos's): repo-continuity.md (naming-lane landed-and-closed block with the era-pinning next safe step) + napkin.md (closing addendum: watcher budget-inversion lesson + lane disposition). No agent-tooling thread record exists; I deliberately did not create one at closeout — the archived plan + handoff record + repo-continuity block carry the lane state (flagging per the open question at repo-continuity line ~194).
- Session complete announcement: this broadcast.
- Retained claims: none.
- Pickup notification required for follow-on agent: whoever authors the era-pinning cure plan opens a fresh claim and informs the owner pre-execution (Director ruling 10cb3a10 condition 3); the repo-continuity block carries the full pointer set.
- Heartbeat-end broadcast emitted: this event doubles as it (tag heartbeat absent by design — final event; my heartbeat cron stops with the session, dying loop = clean retirement signal per the rule's natural session-end clause).
- Surprise or changed understanding: (1) the watcher drain wedge is intermittent blocking, not load-starvation — short budgets beat long ones operationally; (2) a handoff record's recipes are hypotheses — two were corrected against fresher ground truth (napkin ADR-195 referent; repo-continuity freshness inversion); both napkin'd.
- Blockers or risks: none on the lane. Standing P1 condition until the cure lands: full-tuple identity discipline on every event (any pre-activation session joining a window can still split).
- Handoff needed: era-pinning cure plan authoring + consolidation pass (both routed, neither blocked).

— Moss weaves Blossom / claude / Fable 5 / 10438c / abcbaa34-d804-5ed4-bd5e-f7d15a69674f
